reads: brand brain: kit voice, tone, do/don't, learnings (learn-my-brand, analyze-performance)
brand brain: claims sign-off marker in learnings + 'Claims you may use' must facts, with proof in the 'Brand record — <brand>' document (learn-my-brand); before sign-off, plain product facts only
brand brain: operating rules, disclosure, topics off limits via knowledge_search (learn-my-brand); person-post approver (this playbook, asked once and saved as a fact)
this week's focus, promotions, launches via knowledge_search and campaign_read (the human / plan-campaign)
workspace research/market/voc-bank.md and personas.md, or their brand documents (research-market)
brand_read organic: own TikTok/IG posts with metrics and posted_at; competitor top posts (server sync)
social_account_list + social_strategy_get: managed TikTok/IG accounts and their strategy (the product; this playbook after a yes)
social_analytics_get: managed account metrics when connected (server sync)
workspace content/repurposed/* and content/drafts/*: social cuts; content/channels.md platform list (make-content)
campaign brief with organic leg via campaign_read (plan-campaign)
workspace brand/voices/<handle>.md and content/pov/*.md (make-content or this playbook)
workspace social/calendar/*, social/accounts.md (this playbook, earlier runs)
the account's own posts via data_call_provider, verified endpoints only (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn company; LinkedIn/Threads searches author-matched), under spend-gate
workspace 'Graphic ready:' lines under this playbook's request lines (make-static-ads)
web search and the host browser: how each platform works now (dated sources), niche top accounts and posts, the brand's and person's public profiles (free)

research-market's latest report (newest research/market/<date>-read.md, section 'What people are saying': trends with post-by dates, themes, risks; check its window line), buyer language (research-market)
workspace social/research/<date>-<platform>.md from earlier runs (this playbook; refreshed after 30 days)
writes: workspace social/calendar/<start-date>.md: calendar, format tests and their verdicts, drafts, checks, flags, posting sheet, reconciliation (the human; the next run; analyze-performance for what went out); reconciled calendars also imported as brand documents
workspace social/accounts.md: account roster, jobs, pillars, mix, series, time zone, posting tool, free windows (the next run)
workspace social/audit/<date>.md: account audit (the human; the next run's baseline)
workspace brand/voices/<handle>.md: voice cards (make-content and any copy playbook; imported as brand documents once confirmed)
brand learnings via the shared save-learning atom: rules the marketer stated or confirmed, prefix [social YYYY-MM-DD]
social_strategy_upsert: pillars/voice/rules for managed TikTok/IG accounts, after a yes (the product's own generator)
social_post_create render:false: free draft posts on managed TikTok/IG accounts, optional, after a yes (the human in the product)
social_post_update patch status posted: record of what the human posted on managed accounts (analytics placements)
workspace 'Graphic needed:' request lines in social/calendar (make-static-ads answers them)
workspace social/calendar/<start-date>-sheet.csv posting sheet, with a file_url download link in hosted chats (the marketer's own scheduler)
workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md: one line per paid proxy read (spend-gate; shared price history)

the social plan report via write-report: a local file with a link (or an artifact in hosted chat) plus a brand document via save-to-brain, 'Social plan — <Brand> — <date>' (the marketer; analyze-performance)
workspace social/research/<date>-<platform>.md: platform card, niche examples and patterns, own-account read (the next run)
a paused automation (automation_upsert) for the two-week refill, only after the marketer's yes (the coworker's scheduled runs)
